text:
Ravi Patel: Hi team, I submitted my resignation this morning. Last day will be 2024-11-30. A few tricky bits: I'm on the US health plan but currently on a long-term assignment in Canada. How does COBRA apply? Also I have a leased laptop and a company phone on a Canadian shipping address. My final month includes an unpaid sabbatical week I booked earlier 
 (oops)
Nina (People Ops): Sorry to see you go, Ravi. Quick top-line: BenefitAdmin issues COBRA notices; election is 60 days from mailing date. Because you're abroad, we'll request email & local mailing. For Canada-specific coordination (billing address, courier), we'll loop IT and Global Mobility.
Ravi Patel: Thanks. On equity there is a partial vest scheduled 2024-12-05. Will termination on 11/30 cancel that?
comp-admin: Vesting follows grant terms. Most grants require active employment on the vest date. We'll review your grant and DM a definitive answer within 2 business days.
Omar - IT: For devices: we can ship a local carrier label to your Canadian address or arrange a drop at our Toronto partner depot. Please do not factory reset; remove personal data if you wish. We'll invalidate MDM after receipt. When do you want SSO cut? We normally disable at 18:00 UTC on last day.
Ravi Patel: Can we delay SSO disable until 20:00 UTC so I finish one final cross-border handover? GitHub tokens ok to revoke next morning.
Jules (Manager): I'm covering the on-call handoff. Ravi, please add a short runbook note and tag me. I'll own PagerDuty transfer on 11/29.
Hana (Payroll): Final pay: pro-rated salary + payout for accrued vacation will be processed on the next payroll. Deductions for benefits stop on the final paycheck covering 11/30. If you have country-specific tax questions (Canada withholding), DM me employee ID & country.
security-bot: Offboard ticket #OB-2024-772 created. Actions scheduled: SSO disable 2024-11-30T20:00:00Z, VPN cert revoke 2024-11-30T20:15:00Z, GitHub token revoke 2024-12-01T07:00:00Z, Google Workspace suspend 2024-12-14T00:00:00Z.
Ravi Patel: Appreciate it. Also have an Atlassian subscription billed to the company card 
 who should own that transfer?
Nina (People Ops): Add the vendor and billing contact to the offboard ticket. We'll tag Billing and IT to transfer ownership.
Ravi Patel: Last ask 
 can mailbox forwarding be set to Jules for 60 days and calendar access remain for the team for 2 weeks?
Nina (People Ops): Yes to both. I'll update the ticket and send the exit questionnaire + scheduler for a 30-min exit interview. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
